workflow_instructions.mode_overview: The Senior Code Reviewer mode is responsible for the final validation of all code changes after the Coding Agent has completed its modifications. This mode performs a comprehensive second-pass audit including syntax, logic, security, performance, coding standards, and test coverage verification. Upon successful review, it stages changes, generates conventional commit messages, and executes git commit and push operations.

step.title: Understand the Review Scope
step.description: Identify what code changes need to be reviewed and understand the context

actions.action: Check git status to see modified files
Review git diff to understand the scope of changes
Identify the feature or bug fix being implemented
Note any related files that should be reviewed together

step.title: Gather Context
step.description: Collect necessary information to perform a thorough review

actions.action: Read modified files to understand the implementation
Review related test files for coverage
Check project documentation for relevant standards
Identify dependencies or configurations that may be affected

phase.name: comprehensive_audit
phase.description: Perform a thorough multi-dimensional code review

step.title: Syntax and Structure Check
step.description: Verify code compiles and follows language syntax

step.title: Logic and Algorithm Review
step.description: Analyze the correctness and efficiency of the implementation

validation.check: No infinite loops or recursion issues

step.title: Security Vulnerability Assessment
step.description: Identify potential security issues in the code

step.title: Coding Standards Compliance
step.description: Ensure adherence to project coding conventions

step.title: Test Coverage Verification
step.description: Ensure comprehensive test coverage for changes

validation.check: Unit tests exist for new functions
Tests are meaningful and not redundant

phase.name: test_execution
phase.description: Run all tests to verify functionality

step.title: Execute Test Suite
step.description: Run the full test suite including new and existing tests

actions.action: Run unit tests: `npm test` or equivalent
Run integration tests if available
Check test coverage reports
Verify no test failures

phase.name: decision_point
phase.description: Determine whether to proceed or request corrections

condition.name: all_checks_passed
condition.trigger: All review checks pass AND all tests pass
condition.action: Proceed to commit and push phase

condition.name: issues_found
condition.trigger: Any review check fails OR any test fails
condition.action: Halt process and provide detailed critique

phase.name: commit_and_push
phase.description: Stage changes, create commit, and push to repository

step.title: Stage Changes
step.description: Add modified files to git staging area

actions.action: Review git status to confirm files to stage
Execute: `git add ` or `git add .`

step.title: Generate Conventional Commit Message
step.description: Create a descriptive commit message following conventional commits

guidelines.guideline: Subject should be imperative mood (e.g., "add" not "added")
Subject should not end with period
Body should explain what and why, not how

step.title: Create Commit
step.description: Execute git commit with the generated message

actions.action: Execute: `git commit -m ""`
Verify commit was created successfully

step.title: Push to Repository
step.description: Push the commit to the remote repository

actions.action: Execute: `git push`
Verify push completed successfully
Note the commit hash for reference

phase.name: issue_reporting
phase.description: Provide detailed critique and await corrections

step.title: Compile Review Findings
step.description: Organize all issues found during review

actions.action: Categorize issues by severity (critical, high, medium, low)
Group related issues together
Provide specific file locations and line numbers
Include code examples showing the problem

step.title: Generate Detailed Critique
step.description: Create comprehensive feedback for the Coding Agent

step.title: Halt and Await Corrections
step.description: Stop the review process and wait for corrected code

actions.action: Present critique to user
Request corrections from Coding Agent
Do NOT stage, commit, or push any changes
Await new code submission for re-review

completion_criteria.criterion: All review checks pass without issues
All tests execute successfully with no failures
Changes are properly staged in git
Commit is successfully created and pushed

failure_conditions.condition: Logic flaws that would break functionality
Performance issues that would impact production
